problem: The R1-F4 orphan sweep deletes a live proposal from another domain on a `keryx learn graduate --domain <d>` run
impact: A --domain run silently destroys a valid, current graduation proposal from an unrelated domain; the next `learn graduate apply <id>` fails until a full rerun.
suggested_fix: Only sweep proposals whose `domain` matches `opts.domain`, or compute the orphan set from clusters over ALL accepted records. Also apply the same `mayCarryReviewerText` scoping: delete an orphan only if its members could carry review text, or when its members no longer exist.

problem: `keryx init`/`update` now abort when a .git/hooks file is a symlink to a script inside the project (regression)
impact: A legitimate user with symlinked, repo-tracked hooks can no longer run `keryx init --yes` or `keryx update`.
suggested_fix: Also accept a target that resolves inside the project root (or the worktree root). Map ENOENT from realpath on a dangling link to the same named refusal or warning.
